issues.description: SealSaloon's constructor signature is inconsistent with the problem statement/UML. The specification requires a constructor `SealSaloon(String)` (saloon name parameter), but the provided solution implements only a no-argument constructor `SealSaloon()`. This can cause students to implement the wrong public API and may break tests expecting the String constructor.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the solution (and any provided template skeleton, if added) to implement `public SealSaloon(String name)` as required. Initialize `orders` to an empty array inside this constructor; optionally store `name` in a private field and provide a getter. If keeping `SealSaloon()` for backward compatibility, delegate it to `this("")`.
